max_area.py.description: After moving left, compares nums[left] to nums[right - 1] instead of nums[left - 1], so a taller left line is skipped. max_area([1, 5, 10, 6]) returns 3 instead of 10.

three_sum.py.description: After finding a triplet, left is not advanced past equal values, so the same triplet is added twice. three_sum([-2, 0, 0, 2, 2], 0) returns [[0, 2, -2], [0, 2, -2]].

palindrome.py.description: When the left pointer meets the right one while skipping non-alphanumeric characters, the function returns False instead of True. is_palindrome('a,,a') and is_palindrome(',,,') return False.
Dead code: the right skip loop always stops on the character the left pointer already found, so this return False can never run. Unreachable for every string up to length 8 over 'a', 'b', ','.

product_except_self.py.description: [] * len(nums) creates empty lists, so the first index assignment raises IndexError. Should be [1] * len(nums).
The skip condition checks i == len(nums), which is never true, so the first iteration reads right_reuslts[len(nums)] and raises IndexError. Should be i == len(nums) - 1.

user_utils.py.description: not (flags ^ flags) is always True, so the second condition does nothing. The function is still correct: it returns bool(flags & 8).

store.py.description: process_payment records raw_subtotal (before discount and tax) as charged_amount instead of total_amount. With 1 Laptop and SUMMER10 the record says 1200.0 instead of 1263.6.
validate_cart checks stock per entry, not per item total. Two entries of item_01 with quantity 6 pass with stock 10; the second deduct_stock then does nothing, so 12 are sold and stock ends at 4.
calculate_total ignores the ENABLE_DISCOUNTS setting. With it set to False, SUMMER10 still gives 1263.6 for 1 Laptop instead of 1404.0.
